tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground behind every panel. `text` reads 16.3:1, `muted` 6.6:1 here.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels: category rail, gallery, inspector, top bar.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Raised rows inside a panel: card foot, hovered list row, toast.

tokens.name: panel-3
tokens.usage: Selected / active fill: active segment, pressed button, selected rail item.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed ground of inputs, selects and segmented controls.

tokens.name: card-ground
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind a source thumbnail or monitor picture.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between panels and list rows. Decorative only (1.4:1) - never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Control borders as shipped (1.52:1 on `panel`, below the 3:1 floor). Keep for resting borders; pair with a fill change so state never relies on it.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Hover border for buttons, inputs and tiles (2.39:1 on `panel`); the fill change carries the state.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-2`, `panel-3`, `well` and `accent-soft` (11.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, field labels, metadata on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-2`, `panel-3`, `well` (5.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: As shipped: 3.16:1 on `panel` - FAILS 4.5:1. Use only for disabled text and placeholder glyphs; use `dim-aa` for any text people must read.

tokens.name: dim-aa
tokens.usage: PROPOSED replacement for `dim`: tertiary text (timestamps, counters) on `panel` and `panel-2` (5.0:1).

tokens.name: pgm
tokens.usage: PROGRAM tally: on-air ring, PGM monitor border, live dot. As text only 15px+ bold on `panel` (4.9:1). Never an action colour.

tokens.name: pgm-glow
tokens.usage: Outer glow of the on-air ring (`glow-pgm`).

tokens.name: pgm-fill
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Fill under white labels: PGM tally tag, CUT key, ไลฟ์ (live) button while on air (white 4.83:1). `pgm` itself under white is 3.76:1.

tokens.name: pgm-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `pgm` text in status chips (4.7:1).

tokens.name: pvw
tokens.usage: PREVIEW tally: next-up ring, PVW monitor border. As text on `panel` 8.1:1.

tokens.name: pvw-glow
tokens.usage: Outer glow of the preview ring (`glow-pvw`).

tokens.name: pvw-fill
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Fill under white labels: PVW tally tag (white 5.02:1). The shipped #16a34a is 3.3:1.

tokens.name: pvw-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `pvw` text in status chips (6.7:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Transition / armed state: AUTO key, active tab underline, recording-armed, warnings. Text on `panel` 9.0:1.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `amber` text in warning chips (7.8:1).

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Label on an `amber` fill (9.5:1). Never white on amber (2.0:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: As shipped: focus outline and info. Superseded by `accent-line` for focus.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE one interaction colour: primary button fill, selected tile ring, slider fill, toggle on. White label 4.61:1.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selected borders, the + on asset tiles (5.3:1 on `panel`, 4.5:1 on `panel-3`).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on `panel` (7.7:1) and `accent-soft` (6.0:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the selected rail item, info chips, drop-target highlight.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an `accent`, `pgm-fill` or `pvw-fill` fill.

families.sans: "Inter", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Inter for Latin, IBM Plex Sans Thai for Thai (Google Fonts). 12px is the floor for Thai text.
